research_result.description: Clay is a data enrichment and GTM platform that provides REST APIs, an agent CLI plugin, and an MCP server to search databases, execute routines, and run AI research workflows.
research_result.credential_requirements: API keys can be created under Settings -> Account -> API keys (beta) or via the agent plugin. OAuth 2.0 credentials for MCP can be obtained via Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) at https://api.clay.com/oauth/register. Access requires a free trial or paid plan.

evidence.claim: Clay supports API key authentication for its Public API via the clay-api-key header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Every request to the Clay Public API must include a Clay API key in the `clay-api-key` header.

evidence.claim: Clay supports OAuth 2.0 authentication with mandatory PKCE for connecting platforms to its MCP server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Pick the type by whether your client can keep a secret. PKCE is mandatory either way.

evidence.claim: Clay access requires a 14-day free trial or paid subscription plan.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Clay offers a 14-day free trial with 1,000 data credits, giving you access to webhooks, CRM integrations, email sequencers, and HTTP API capabilities.

evidence.claim: Clay provides a REST API for programmatic search, enrichment routines, and table queries.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Clay's REST API for programmatic access to the GTM platform — search Clay's proprietary database of companies and people, run Clay-managed functions, custom functions and Workflows as routines

evidence.claim: Clay provides an official hosted MCP server for AI tools and agent integration.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Clay exposes a Model Context Protocol(MCP) server that lets an external platform — an AI assistant, IDE, agent host, or partner product — run Clay's find-and-enrich tools and custom functions on behalf of a signed-in Clay user.
